description: This file implements an IndexedDB storage adapter for onboarding store, supporting large data storage (e.g., images) with fallback to localStorage, and integrates with zustand persistence via createJSONStorage.

methods.name: getDB
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the IndexedDB database connection, with caching and upgrade handling.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Fetches an item from IndexedDB or falls back to localStorage if IndexedDB fails.

methods.name: setItem
methods.description: Stores an item in IndexedDB or falls back to localStorage if IndexedDB fails.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from IndexedDB or falls back to localStorage if IndexedDB fails.
